title: Pasulka meets Tyler and begins an emergent collaboration

tellings.quote: meets this person named Tyler who's part of the first tradition right the secret tradition and what happens is a collaboration and then a transparency that we've never seen before

plain: Diana Pasulka, who writes about UFOs and religion, tells Michels that over roughly 2010 to 2023 she met a man named Tyler, who she says belongs to "the first tradition," which she calls "the secret tradition." She says the meeting grew into a collaboration, and then into "a transparency that we've never seen before." If true, it would mean people inside a hidden world of UFO knowledge have begun to open up to outsiders.
